description:
Add the OTEL crate family to crates/mail/Cargo.toml under a new 'otel' feature flag, and extend the config schema with an [observability] section.

## Crates to add
  opentelemetry          # core API
  opentelemetry_sdk      # SDK + tracer provider
  opentelemetry-otlp     # OTLP gRPC exporter (features: grpc-tonic)
  tracing-opentelemetry  # bridge: tracing spans → OTEL spans
  opentelemetry-http     # W3C TraceContext propagator

All gated behind a Cargo feature 'otel' so the binary compiles and runs without an ADOT sidecar in dev/test environments.

## Config schema addition (config.rs)
  [observability]
  enabled       = false          # default off; set true in prod
  otlp_endpoint = 'http://localhost:4317'  # ADOT sidecar default
  service_name  = 'stoa-mail'
  sampling_rate = 1.0            # 0.0–1.0; start at 1.0, tune down at volume

## Acceptance
- cargo build -p stoa-mail compiles with and without --features otel
- Config struct deserializes correctly from TOML with and without the [observability] section (default values apply when section absent)
title: Add OTEL crate deps and config schema
